cs.t: Hmm, interesting. My monitor (Samsung P2770) has a menu option to enable grayscale, which I have just switched on. I am not sure that I could use this permanently but it does seem to be easier on the eyes. The icon in my taskbar that is currently flashing away is certainly less distracting. However... my vim colour scheme is now useless, and I am about to review some mockups from a web designer, so this might be a short experiment.
I had to replace the caps in my SyncMaster 204B.  The problem was so pervasive that I ordered a kit for my monitor online that had all the caps I needed for this particular monitor.
